name: webmcp
description: Northwind Bikes with WebMCP: two declarative tool forms (search_products, and place_order with toolautosubmit) on index.html and an inline script registering get_return_policy (readOnlyHint), delete_account (mutating, no consequentialHint) and add_to_cart (consequentialHint) via document.modelContext ?? navigator.modelContext at load time.

notes.webmcp: Expected tool list: declarative search_products, place_order; imperative get_return_policy, delete_account, add_to_cart. The imperative script is webmcp.js, loaded only on index.html, and executes synchronously at load (no event gating). <meta name=generator content=fixture> is present on every page.
notes.webmcp-tool-annotations: Two intentional defects: delete_account has a mutating name and no consequentialHint; place_order is a declarative form with toolautosubmit.
